name: procwatch
description: Resident process-create telemetry: a compiled-in watch samples the process table on a fixed cadence and buffers creation rows, and recon.procwatch flushes the rows since the last ask -- the implant-native tier's first real entry.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and a source tree under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver; the sources compile into an artifact only when a build names the extension. On the target, the watch is one thread of the implant's own process and a bounded in-memory buffer -- nothing on disk, no named trace session, no extra process per ask. The sampling sweep reads the process table (the /proc tree, the toolhelp snapshot) on a fixed two-second cadence, which is itself a measurable pattern on the host; the rows ride the task channel into the audit chain like any task output.
